name: Chart markers
description: Marker set for Bravo trades. The app calls createChartMarkers({ order, overrides }) to choose which marker components run, in drawing order; all results are drawn in one call.
_comment: Each marker type has its own component.json in chart/markers/marker-*. The drawing order and per-app overrides come from the app. shownGates are the skip reasons drawn without showDiagnostics.
